project_title: Steam Dependency & LUA Injector - High-Tactical Game Launcher
archetype_style: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL CYBER LAUNCHER
context: Hybrid Desktop Launcher Client (Steam DLL & LUA File Injector) + Cloud Sync Web Admin Panel
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-mode high-performance gaming application: an Electron-styled Steam Launcher Client interface AND a Web Admin Management Dashboard.

Implement Steam file injection flow simulation for games with App IDs: DLLs copied directly to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\, and .lua files containing App ID copied to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\config\lua.
Ensure explicit interactive states, injection animated feedback progress bars, status badges (Active/Inactive/Injecting), modal file details, and custom path settings.
Use data-testid on every interactive button, input, badge, tab, and card (kebab-case).
DO NOT use transparent header without backdrop blur or solid backgrounds.
Ensure contrast is APCA compliant on all elements (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text).

scale.app_id_tag: font-mono text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-950/80 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30

component_guidelines.shadcn_customization: Customize Shadcn primitives (.jsx files in /src/components/ui/) to strictly match dark tactical aesthetic
interactive_elements: Game library card with hover zoom, steam app id tag, active state badge, and single-click 'Inject / Activate' button
Activation process drawer or toast with real-time dependency injection breakdown (.dll to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam, .lua to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\config\lua)
Admin Panel tab for creating games, uploading DLLs and LUA files, specifying App ID and selecting poster images
Settings view with configurable Steam directory path (Default: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam), directory status checker, and log viewer

gaming_gear_hero.description: Background hero accent graphic for Launcher Header

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.test_id_rule: MUST add data-testid to every interactive or status element (e.g. data-testid='game-card-223308', data-testid='activate-button-223308', data-testid='steam-path-input').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_transparent_header: Headers and floating bars must have opaque or heavy backdrop-blur backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.hover_contrast: Always set text color explicitly on hover states (e.g. hover:bg-cyan-500 hover:text-black).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Maintain clean 16px to 32px padding in container cards to prevent text collision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for injection status updates ('DLL injected into Steam root', '.lua script loaded to config/lua').
